# Hyper Digital

> Hyper Digital is a New Zealand digital marketing agency that helps trade and local businesses (plumbers, electricians, roofers, builders, HVAC, painters and similar) win more work through Google Ads, smart websites and AI automation. Based in Hawke's Bay, working with tradies NZ-wide since 2019. 107 Kiwi businesses helped since 2019, rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews.

We focus on real outcomes for trade businesses: more phone calls and booked jobs at a predictable cost per lead, not vanity metrics. Every result we publish is something the client can verify in their own Google Ads, Search Console or Analytics account. Every website enquiry gets an instant automatic reply, 24/7.

- Location: Hawke's Bay, New Zealand. Working with tradies nationwide.
- Phone: 027 666 1973
- Email: sales@hyperdigital.nz
- Pricing: one-off $1,997 +GST setup, then monthly plans from $497 +GST (Starter), $697 (Growth) or $997 (Scale). Ad spend is separate and never marked up. Ads-only management from $545 +GST/month all-inclusive.
- Guarantee: hit the agreed lead goal in 60 days, or we work for free until we do.
- No lock-in contracts. One month's notice; every marketing asset (campaigns, landing pages, tracking) transfers to the client in full.

## Services

- [Google Ads management](https://hyperdigital.nz/google-ads): Certified Google Partner. Search, Shopping, Display, YouTube and remarketing campaigns that book real jobs, not clicks.
- [Facebook and Instagram ads](https://hyperdigital.nz/facebook-ads): Meta Business Partner. Facebook and Instagram campaigns measured on enquiries and cost per lead, not likes.
- [Lead generation](https://hyperdigital.nz/lead-generation): The right channel for each trade: Google Ads for fast results, local SEO built in, Meta when it's worth it.
- [Smart websites](https://hyperdigital.nz/websites): Fast, mobile-first, search-ready websites that reply to every enquiry instantly, qualify the job and book it, 24/7.
- [AI automation](https://hyperdigital.nz/ai-automation): Instant lead replies, AI chat that qualifies and books jobs, automated email follow-up, payments on booking and review generation.

## Results and case studies

- [Results overview](https://hyperdigital.nz/results): Traceable results: 107 Kiwi businesses since 2019, $1m+ ad spend managed, $4m+ tracked client revenue.
- [Bermuda Lifestyle (Pools & Spas)](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/bermuda-lifestyle): New website plus Google, Facebook and Instagram drove 2,500% more enquiries and 500% revenue growth in year one.
- [Harris Pumps & Filtration](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/harris-pumps): Cost per lead cut from $31 to around $17, with 29% more tracked leads.
- [Tableau Towbars](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/tableau-towbars): Conversion rate up from 9% to 12%, roughly 7x return on ad spend on a lean budget.
- [Houses On The Move (House Relocations)](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/houses-on-the-move): Cost per lead cut by more than half across a two-sided marketplace.
- [No Drips (Plumbing & Gas)](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/no-drips): Plumbing leads from as little as $14, well under the $45 target, after cutting inherited wasted spend.
- [Napier Plumber](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/napier-plumber): 543 tracked enquiries in 12 months, ads leads at about $13 each.
- [Hawke's Bay Roofer](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/hawkes-bay-roofer): $351 of ads traced to a $45,000 re-roof job in a single month.
- [Continuous Spouting (Spouting & Guttering)](https://hyperdigital.nz/results/continuous-spouting): A single tightly managed campaign delivering leads at under $6 each.
